avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces methylprednisolone levels and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates mineralocorticoid effects, increases hypertension and hypokalemia risk with corticosteroids
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use with methylprednisolone

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Long-term corticosteroid use increases bone loss; supplementation helps mitigate osteoporosis risk
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation; monitor bone density with prolonged therapy

caution_supplements.name: Zinc
caution_supplements.mechanism: Corticosteroids may increase urinary zinc loss; deficiency impairs immune function
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; consider supplementation if deficient during prolonged use

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Corticosteroids alter gut flora; probiotics may support GI health without direct interaction
caution_supplements.action: May be beneficial for GI tolerance; select quality products

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases methylprednisolone levels and adverse effects risk

caution_foods.name: High-Sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Corticosteroids promote sodium retention; excessive intake increases hypertension risk
caution_foods.action: Moderate sodium intake; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Simple Carbohydrates/Sugary Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Corticosteroids impair glucose metabolism; high glycemic foods elevate diabetes risk
caution_foods.action: Limit simple sugars; monitor glucose levels, especially in at-risk patients

caution_foods.name: High-Potassium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Corticosteroids may cause hypokalemia; excessive potassium intake less likely to cause problems but monitor
caution_foods.action: Monitor serum potassium levels; adjust intake based on lab values

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium), glucose, and blood pressure regularly during corticosteroid therapy. Long-term use requires bone density assessment and calcium/vitamin D supplementation to prevent osteoporosis.
